name: 16803 · State College, PA
findings: ZIP 16803 (State College) has 128 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16803 (State College) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
